title: Train Schema
description: Schema for train definitions orchestrating multi-wagon workflows with theme-based numbering
$comment: Trains carry a typed identity `train:<subject>:<slug>` (issue #1421). The classification the legacy [Theme][Category][Variation] numbering encoded now rides as FIELDS — `themes`, `category` (nominal|error|alternate|exception) and `sort_key` — so reclassifying a train edits metadata instead of renaming it. The category digit is retired (issues #1421, #1440); nothing may derive a category by parsing an identity.

train_id.description: Typed train identity (issue #1421): train:<subject>:<slug> (e.g. train:artifact-identity:migrate-with-alias). `category` is a validated field, not an identity digit. The legacy hierarchical form `NNNN-slug` is still accepted DURING the migration transition (schema-first, data-follows) and is retired once worker C4 relocates every train.

category.description: Train variant category (issue #1421): a validated FIELD, never an identity digit. Replaces the second digit of the legacy NNNN identity — a reclassification now changes metadata, not the identity. Optional during the migration transition; to become required once C4's data migration lands.

sort_key.description: Optional ordinal used to order trains within a subject/category bucket, replacing the ordering the legacy variation digits carried in the identity (issue #1421).

title.description: Human-readable display name for the train

description.description: Concise description of the train's purpose and workflow

family.description: Train family (planner.train.family): behavior (express/exercise a capability, no authority commit) or delivery (commits accepted-system state via an Acceptance Authority commit, terminating in platform:acceptance:commit-receipt). Orthogonal to the variant category; derived from the declared terminal contract; never encoded in the train id. Optional during the #1083 transition; to become required.

path.description: Canonical path to the train YAML file relative to repo root

file.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'path' instead. Alias for backward compatibility

themes.description: Theme categories this train belongs to

items.description: Kebab-case theme name. Built-in defaults (commons, mechanic, scenario, match, sensory, player, league, audience, monetization, partnership) may be overridden via the `themes` block in `.atdd/config.yaml`. Runtime validation resolves the effective map via `get_theme_map(config)` from `atdd.coach.utils.theme_map`.

primary_wagon.description: The primary wagon responsible for this train's core functionality

dependencies.description: Other trains that must run before this train

items.description: Train reference: typed train:<subject>:<slug> (issue #1421), or the legacy train:NNNN-slug form accepted during the migration transition.

source_interlocking.description: OPTIONAL back-reference to the interlocking route this train was generated from or justified by (issue #1248). Pure traceability — it must NOT alter train linearity and is NOT a second execution source. The interlocking remains authoritative for the guarded route space; this train remains the single runtime-executable linear path.

route_id.description: The route within the interlocking that maps to this train.

projection_digest.description: Optional sha256 of the normalized route projection for drift detection.

participants.description: Wagons, users, and systems involved in this train

oneOf.description: List of backend test file paths

test.description: Test file references for this train (string, array, or object with backend/frontend/frontend_python)

oneOf.description: List of backend implementation file paths

code.description: Implementation file references for this train (string, array, or object with backend/frontend/frontend_python)

frontend_python.description: Whether frontend Python (Streamlit) implementation is expected

expectations.description: Explicit expectations for which platforms this train should be implemented on

status.description: Current implementation status of the train

sequence.description: Ordered linear steps defining the train workflow. Trains are strictly linear: no loops or routes. New journeys require new trains.

acceptances.description: Train-level acceptance criteria. Mirror of the WMBT acceptance shape (substrate spec v12 §5.2). Each entry contributes a derived rule to the registry via the repo-rule walker — the rule-id derives from identity.urn per §3.3, so the acceptance block MUST NOT include an id: field at the top level (the per-acceptance identity.id field is allowed for human reference).

id.description: Optional human-facing label (e.g. AC-SMOKE-001). NOT used for rule-id derivation.

purpose.description: One-line statement of what this acceptance enforces (becomes RuleMetadata.description).

phase.description: ATDD lifecycle phase the acceptance dispatches to.
